license_note: Both the repository and the model weights are released under Moonshot AI's Modified MIT License, which reproduces the MIT grant but requires commercial products above 100 million monthly active users or 20 million US dollars in monthly revenue to prominently display 'Kimi K2'. That conditional attribution obligation is not part of the OSI-approved MIT text, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking repository code and model weights, including derivative works

access_boundary: This record represents the moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking repository release at commit a51ccc050d73dab088bf7b0e2dd9b30ae85a4e55 (last modified 2026-01-30), whose checkpoint is natively INT4. Kimi-K2-Instruct, Kimi-K2-Base, the 0905 Instruct update, the turbo API variant, the Moonshot AI API, and downstream requantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Moonshot AI publishes the INT4 compressed-tensors checkpoint with an in-repository deployment guide covering vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers configurations
The repository carries its own license file, a third-party notices file, and a tool-calling guide
tradeoffs: The Modified MIT License adds a usage-threshold attribution obligation, so the release is source-available rather than open source
Moonshot AI's platform lists kimi-k2-thinking as a deprecated API model, and the model card carries no release date or versioning statement
